short_description: 37th Bangkok Marathon takes place January 10, 2027 in Bangkok, Thailand.
ai_summary: 37th Bangkok Marathon is a road running event in Bangkok, Thailand, featuring Full Marathon (42.195KM), Half Marathon (21.1KM), Mini Marathon (10KM), Micro Marathon. The race takes place on January 10, 2027, starting from Sanam Chai Road, beside the Grand Palace, Bangkok. Registration is Not yet open (opens nationwide 1 Jul 2026) as of the last check.
